claims.statement: The EU Batteries Regulation aims to strengthen collection, recycling and material recovery across battery lifecycles.
Commission rules published in 2025 define calculation and verification of recycling efficiency and material-recovery rates for waste batteries.

economics.acquisition_route: Secure three recycler anchors, then sell planning access to EPR organisations
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated: 1m reserved tonnes across EU corridors at 30 PLN net per tonne could create 30m PLN revenue; even a narrower foothold could support over 5m PLN founder equity in years 6-9
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated: 65-80% after technical screening and support
economics.pricing: Unvalidated: 20-50 PLN per reserved tonne plus 1-2% settlement fee
economics.retention_or_repeat: Rolling quarterly forecasts and annual EPR obligations

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Verified capacity, rejection and recovery-rate history create a defensible planning benchmark
fingerprint.customer: Battery producers, EPR organisations, collectors and recyclers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: EPR organisations, battery associations and collection contractors
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Forward capacity calendar, chemistry compatibility screening, take-or-pay templates and result-document vault
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Capacity buyer pays reservation fee; recycler pays commission when booked tonnes are accepted
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Forecast waste volume lacks contracted compliant treatment capacity

founder_fit: Optimization and forecasting suit the founder

structure.control_point: forward recycler capacity inventory tied to accepted chemistries
structure.critical_dependency: Licensed recyclers must expose reliable capacity and permit third-party reservations

thesis: Allow producers and collectors to reserve future tonnes at documented EU battery recyclers, with standardized chemistry profiles and recycling-result evidence.
title: Waste-Battery Recycling Capacity Forward Book
uncertainties: Actual capacity scarcity, fees and tonnage are unvalidated
Cross-border shipment economics may erase value
